subject: FIELD UPDATE V2: Hall-triggered early physical wake remains successful; intermittent-looking misses are dominated by opening-attempt segmentation
body: Fresh physical Fold7 diagnostics from DuoOpen-ZFold7-5.1.0-beta2-optABC-inner-physical-bridge-v2-debug.apk materially refine the P0. The SW_LID/Hall reader is healthy and extremely early: 14 recorded lid edges (7 open, 7 closed) arrived with 0.095-2.512 ms source-to-app lag, median ~0.232 ms. Ten semantic opening attempts were minted. Across 11 WAKE_RESULT receipts (attempt 4 retried once), every receipt reported ok=true and physicalPowered=true against stable INNER physical id 4630946449689556883; therefore this bundle does not support a simple 'V2 stopped issuing physical wake' regression. Instead, multiple Hall-started openings are cancelled by the continuity FSM when Samsung briefly reports an intermediate still-folded posture. Attempts 1, 2, 3, 6 and 9 begin immediately on lid-switch-open, then OPENING_FROM_CLOSED returns to NATIVE_COVER roughly 90-118 ms later under native-cover-authoritative before Samsung later advances to device-state 1->2 and a new opening attempt is minted. Attempts 4, 7 and 10 are those later device-state restarts. This can look optically like 'the screen did not turn on / did not stay on' even though an early physical wake transaction was issued. Attempts 5 and 8 show Hall-started openings that continue directly into INNER handoff. Physical wake call latency is still variable (0-300 ms observed) and remains a secondary latency concern. No early disabled INNER logical route was found by the wake probe in any result (routeProbeCount=6, routeFirstSeenMs=-1, innerLogical=-1); Samsung later changes topology so INNER becomes default/active. Human observation remains authoritative for visible pixels: V1 was reported to turn INNER on consistently; V2 has perceived intermittent misses. Do not collapse command success into optical proof.
